text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival.
As a token of gratitude to their fans, the Umamusume
entertain them through various sporting events.

It looks like Biko Pegasus is going to
participate in the dodgeball tournament—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for inviting me.
I look forward to spending today with you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so much for inviting
someone like Rice...!
I... I'll do my best...!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All riiiiight! The hero team is assembled!
We're definitely gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Fan's Voice
text_block_list.text:
"Don't give up, Biko!"
"We're cheering for you, Grass!"
"Rice-chan! Do your beeeest!!"
choice_data_list: Gotta answer the fans' cheers too!
We've got to answer the fans' cheers too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Of course! Leave it to us!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mm...! A-All right...!!
And so the match began, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My heart is a tranquil water surface,
yet my fighting spirit is a blazing flame... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Like an arrow shot at the target—
I shall pierce right through!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So cool--!!
Get 'em, Grass-senpai!

Heh... One down, huh?
Not bad dodging skills there.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I did manage to catch it, but...
I have a rather bad feeling about this.

text_block_list.name: Dodgeball Beast
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, that was the first and last time. You ain't ever gonna catch this 'Beast of Dodgeball'!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Here she comes, Grass-senpai...!
She's no ordinary opponent!

text_block_list.name: Dodgeball Beast
text_block_list.text:
Devour everything!!
Absolute Dominance Power Ball Waveeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...!
I-It's awful! Grass is...!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We'll avenge you, Rice-senpai!
Let's show them the bond of the hero team!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! Even Rice—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeeyah!
(Wheeeew... thud)

text_block_list.name: Dodgeball Beast
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha!
You're so weak you're making me yawn!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No way...!

text_block_list.name: Dodgeball Beast
text_block_list.text:
Ayy, nice pass, nice pass!
Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuuu...!!
I wanted to do my best... but to have to give
the ball away like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Dodgeball Beast
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let me show you how it's done.
THIS is what a real fight looks like!

text_block_list.name: Dodgeball Beast
text_block_list.text: Graceful Concentrated Fireeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaー...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...?
Did it... miss?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh...!
I stopped it! How's that for ya...!

text_block_list.name: Dodgeball Beast
text_block_list.text:
"Tch, buzzkill.
...Still, you're pretty battered after just one hit, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...!
It's all Rice's fault...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't let it bother you.
More importantly... let's give it another shot!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“But... if Rice throws it,
you'll just throw it right back...!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Like I care!
Even if it's hit back, I'll return it as many times as it takes!"

text_block_list.name: Dodgeball Beast
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't do it.
For your own good, you'd better throw it yourself, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Rice-senpai is strong!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Standing up for her friends.
Facing powerful rivals head-on without flinching.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Rice-senpai is a hero too!
So she's strong!! She'll be fine!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Rice-senpai, you can do this.
I believe in you too!

text_block_list.name: Fan's Voice
text_block_list.text:
"‘Get 'em, Rice-chaaan!’
‘We're right behind you—!’
‘Give it your aaaaall!’"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Your courage reached so many people!
You have nothing to hesitate about!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's throw everything our—
Hero Team has at them!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Dodgeball Beast
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's this...?! The atmosphere completely shifted?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice isn't weak.
Because she's not alone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My comrades, everyone is helping me win!
This is how a "Hero fights"!!

text_block_list.name: Biko & Rice
text_block_list.text:
Pegasuuuus... SHOOTTT!!
Yaaaaaah~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Dodgeball Beast
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Fans' Cheers
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooahhh!!)
And—the dodgeball tournament ended, bringing the Fan Appreciation Festival to a successful close.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was so much fun!
...It feels like such a waste for it to end.
choice_data_list: It's kinda hard to say goodbye, huh.
It's kinda hard to say goodbye, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: However, the bond forged from fighting together will never fade. Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... We'll meet up again.
Rice and the others... are friends, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the Hero Team will live forever!
Through dodgeball, Biko Pegasus forged a glorious friendship!

The seesaw battle continued on after that.
As a result—

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Game set!
Victory goes to Team Biko Pegasus!"

text_block_list.name: Fans' Cheers
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone!
Trainer said they'll take a commemorative photo for us!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Together with Rice-senpai, Grass-senpai, and all the fans too!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh!? But we were only cheering you on...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about!
Everyone's cheers gave me strength too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, for it is a victory
we could not have achieved on our own.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~~! 
This'll be a memory to last a lifetime!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright, that makes the whole lineup of today's heroes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice is a hero too... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright! Trainer, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Cheeeese!!

Having shared the victory, Biko Pegasus and the others
wrapped up the Fan Appreciation Festival with big smiles!
